english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for thermal heat, hot conditions, and warmth produced by a heater.

examples.english: The heater is still giving off heat, so there’s no need to turn it off yet.
examples.traditional: 暖爐仲有熱力，唔使咁快熄。
examples.jyutping: nyun5 lou4 zung6 jau5 jit6 lik6 m4 sai2 gam3 faai3 sik1
